notes: Time-card entries keyed by refNbr. GET /v1/timecard REQUIRES an employeeCd filter, so this endpoint uses a cartesian employee fanout: one request per employee, sourced from /v1/employee. partition.rs supports a real source_endpoint/source_path dimension (same mechanism as budgets.json), so the fanout is implemented natively rather than disabled. SOURCE-PATH ASSUMPTION (FLAG): employeeCd expects the employee code; source_path is set to 'employeeNumber' (the human-readable EmployeeDto code) rather than the int32 'employeeId'. Verify employeeNumber is the field Visma's timecard employeeCd filter matches for these tenants; if the API expects a different code field, adjust source_path. EDGE CASE: a tenant with zero employees yields no partition values and partition.rs will error ('dimension produced no values'); time cards are tenant_support=optional in v1, so on tenants without the time/project module this endpoint should be skipped at scheduling time. Incremental syncs add lastModifiedDateTime >= watermark on top of employeeCd; full syncs use the baseline.
